definition: Bin Yang (Chinese: 杨彬; Pinyin: Yáng Bīn) is a professor of computer science the department of computer science, Aalborg University.
details: His research interests include data management and machine learning.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Bin Yang.
